msg: There seems to be more than one gameplay.1. Red and purple, brown and green operate as a pair with corresponding low or high scores. So pick red and purple until the score drops to three or less and then swap to the other pair.2. The above strategy does not always work. Another strategy is to choose the same colour of each pair until the score drops to three or less. For example, red and green worked well for a time.3. Try not to be too slow as that seems to decrease the following scores.4. If you get too many low scores together, do the opposite to whatever strategy you were following.
